Item Level: 81
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Fleeting" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters have 10(10-15)% increased Attack, Cast and Movement Speed
{ Prefix Modifier "Destructive" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters have 231(200-240)% increased Critical Hit Chance
Monsters have +22(21-25)% Critical Damage Bonus
{ Prefix Modifier "Shattering" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters Break Armour equal to 30(25-30)% of Physical Damage dealt
{ Prefix Modifier "Precise" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters have 32(30-40)% increased Accuracy Rating
{ Suffix Modifier "of Drought" (Tier: 1) }
Players gain 35(35-30)% reduced Flask Charges
{ Suffix Modifier "of Fatigue" (Tier: 1) }
Players have 28(30-25)% less Cooldown Recovery Rate
{ Suffix Modifier "of Smothering" (Tier: 1) }
Players have 40(40-36)% less Recovery Rate of Life and Energy Shield
{ Suffix Modifier "Flaming" (Tier: 1) }
Area has patches of Ignited Ground

Can be used in a Map Device, allowing you to enter a Map. Waystones can only be used once.
